question: We're developing a blue eyeliner and want to use ferric ammonium ferrocyanide as the colorant. May we, and what restrictions, certification or labeling apply?
key_elements: Yes. 73.2298(b) lists ferric ammonium ferrocyanide for coloring externally applied cosmetics, including cosmetics intended for use in the area of the eye, in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice (no numeric cap). It must conform in identity and specifications to § 73.1298(a)(1) and (b) ((a)). The additive and its color mixtures bear § 70.25 labeling ((c)). Batches are exempt from section 721(c) certification ((d)).

73.2298.tail: ng cosmetics applied to the area of the eye, in amounts consistent with good manufacturing practice.
